items.t: 45% Upside for Constellation Energy? Barclays Thinks So, and Here’s How
items.sum: Key TakeawaysBarclays raised its Constellation Energy price target to $371 from $345 on Nov. 19, 45% above the stock, which trades 33% below its December 2025 high.

items.t: Constellation Energy Sinks 10% in a Week as AI Stocks Slide, Giving Back Its Earnings Jump. Time to Buy?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 10% in the past week as AI stocks sold off, giving back most of its jump on a third-quarter beat and guidance raise. NuScale, Oklo and Cameco fell even more, and most of the week’s analyst news on Constellation was higher price targets.
